verdict.rationale: CoreWeave has no dedicated sandbox or test-mode environment. Users can still build their own isolated test setups: the API and Terraform create and delete separate CKS clusters on demand, each cluster runs in its own private VPC, and group-based bucket policies can restrict access to production data. That makes isolation a do-it-yourself workaround rather than a first-class sandbox. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/staging environment feature, guidance on keeping test workloads away from production data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
